data.name: Turtle Snorkeling Adventure + Guaranteed Sightings
data.headline: All ages • 2 Hours
data.description:
Set sail on a two-hour journey to the shallow, vibrant coral reefs of the world-famous Waikiki "Turtle Canyon." Board either our 50-ft double-decker power catamaran or our 55-ft sailing catamaran for this incredible experience.

Our Turtle Canyon snorkeling tour offers plenty of time to meet Hawaii’s friendly green sea turtles and marvel at the colorful underwater world just off Waikiki Beach. Don’t miss this extraordinary adventure – book your tour today!
data.highlights:
- Snorkeling with Hawaiian green sea turtles
- Views of Waikiki Beach from the water
- Sailing aboard either our 50-ft double-decker power catamaran or our 55-ft sailing catamaran

**Book now and receive Complimentary Waikiki History Tour Cruise Adventure from Pink Sails**
data.itinerary:
- Sail to Turtle Canyon: Enjoy views of Waikiki Beach and the Pacific Ocean
- Snorkeling: Explore the coral reefs and swim with Hawaiian green sea turtles
- Return to the harbor: Relax onboard with light refreshments

data.cancellation_summary: Full refund or credit with 24 hours' notice. No-shows charged full price.
data.cancellation_notes:
Changes, including rescheduling and cancellations, must be made at least **24 hours prior** to your scheduled tour time.

* Customers who provide at least **24 hours’ notice** will receive a **full refund or credit**.
* Customers will also receive a **full refund or credit** if the tour is canceled by the operator due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances.
* **No-shows** will be charged **the full price**.

To cancel or inquire about a change, please **contact us by phone** at (808) 922-7722 (Option 2).

---

**Private Charters:**
Cancellations must be made at least **14 days prior** to the scheduled charter date to receive a full refund or credit.
data.check_in_details: Arrive 30 minutes prior to departure for check-in and waivers.
data.special_requirements:
- Must have basic swimming skills for in-water activities.
- No BYOB except on private charters with prior approval.
- Basic swimming skills required
data.disclaimers: Boat assignments, as well as tour times and dates, are subject to change based on availability, weather conditions, and operational requirements. Thank you for your understanding and flexibility.
data.faqs:
- **Can I bring my own alcohol?** No, alcohol is available for purchase onboard. BYOB is only allowed on private charters with prior approval.
- **Where should I park?** Street parking is available for $1 per hour. Only park in white stalls; yellow stalls are permit-only.
